decision_before_tests: Add explicit model/TP-rank ownership, capture-sequence keying and process-lifetime capture pins; reject overlapping host dispatch, duplicate model namespaces, DBO and microbatching before any P4 forward. Preserve sequential-layer activation reuse within one owner and one stream/capture/shape.
found_by_static_audit: The old process-global scratch key did not include a model owner or CUDA capture identity.
External ctypes launches cannot rely on Torch operators to retain sidecar tensors for graph replay.
vLLM use_ubatching may be true with enable_dbo false when ubatch_size exceeds one.
Sorting the readiness layer list could differ from the launcher's literal unsorted environment string.
required_checks: Same-model sequential layers reuse storage; independent model owners cannot share it.
Eager, different capture IDs, different streams and different shapes use disjoint storage.
Captured sidecar and scratch references survive loss of the layer wrapper; no implicit eviction API exists.
A concurrent/reentrant host dispatch on one owner fails before writing scratch and releases its guard on exception.
Actual local vLLM DBO and microbatch configuration source contract is checked.
Startup import/config failures exit 78 before application code, even if error reporting itself fails.
The emitted readiness line satisfies the exact parent run_kld_v3.sh grep for every accepted layer-list syntax.
Offline compilation preserves the native E2M1 K64 instruction, shared-memory and spill constraints.
failure_policy: Preserve numbered test attempts and amend only host/static implementation defects; do not infer device or quality evidence.
claim_limit: Host/static and offline compilation only. Graph replay, concurrency, device closure, KLD and speed remain unqualified. Captured resources are deliberately retained until worker exit pending explicit graph-lifecycle integration.
